input.overview: Plunge the center standup below the upper flipper to set the spinner to 2,500, then shoot the spinner before any spin resets its value. Complete both three-banks to advance Bonus X toward 7x. Build the upper-left horseshoe award to 173,000 before collecting it. For Multiball, advance the numbered drops through 8, hit the flashing ninth target, and use any locked balls: scoring 9 starts three-ball play with two locks, two-ball play with one, and no Multiball with none.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the center skill-shot standup to set the spinner to 2,500, then shoot the spinner. Complete both three-banks for Bonus X, and build the upper-left horseshoe to 173,000 before collecting it. Advance numbers 1 through 8, then score the flashing ninth target; locked balls determine whether that starts Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Max the Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center skill target, then shoot the spinner.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Score the flashing ninth target with one or two balls locked.

steps.text: On the plunge, hit the center standup below the upper flipper to set the spinner to 2,500, then shoot the spinner before a weak spin resets it.
Complete both three-target banks to advance Bonus X toward 7x.
Loop the upper-left horseshoe until its value reaches 173,000, then collect it rather than taking the earlier steps.
Advance numbered targets 1 through 8, then hit the randomly flashing target for 9; with one lock this starts two-ball Multiball, and with two locks it starts three-ball.

alternatives.title: Use the left chute
alternatives.when: Use this when numbered-ball progress or the loop value is more useful than a riskier bank rebound.

steps.text: Shoot the left chute to spot numbered progress and raise its repeat value.
Complete numbers 1 through 8, then score the flashing ninth target.
Preserve the qualified 77,000 Super Bonus for the next ball while continuing to build Bonus X.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count, lock sharing and memory, Extra Ball and Special conversions, and Bonus X maximum.
Test the center skill target, spinner, both three-banks, upper-left horseshoe and standup, eight numbered drops, flashing ninth-target lamps, left chute, and three-ball lock mechanism.

cautions.issue: Any spinner movement resets its built value after the scoring pass.
cautions.response: Shoot it only after setting a useful value, and rebuild before the next attempt.
